samples.text: In the meantime, the inventory valuation service runs on this basis: manual agency code mapping override applied to complete valuation for the period. The current working cause, which the team will keep under test until the incident closes, is: stale legacy-to-new agency code mapping in the reference data register. No budget or prior-month figure applies to either point, so the position is stated as it stands. The override was applied on the strength of that working cause and is the only measure in place. Each overridden code was checked by a data platform engineer against the current cloud code list before the run resumed. A second engineer reviewed the list of overridden codes before release. Confirmed cause for the inventory valuation service: stale legacy-to-new agency code mapping in the reference data register. Root cause classification for the product hierarchy sync service: control failure: the mapping table has no registered owner and no required reviewer. At triage, the working explanation was recorded as overnight ERP outage. Engineers set that explanation aside on this evidence: ERP logs show no interruption during the valuation window. Legacy and cloud agency codes are both in use and are not interchangeable, so every valuation run depends on a correct translation between the two code sets. A translation row that no longer matches the cloud side raises no error when the job loads it. Detection of a bad row therefore depends on a person who reads the output, not on a check inside the pipeline.
